llm_analysis.reasoning: This is Google's broad generalist new-grad posting, and on paper the keyword match is inflated because the stated minimum quals are deliberately loose. The real technical caliber here is strong and arguably above typical new-grad bar in ML and parallel/distributed computing specifically, both of which are explicit Google preferred quals with genuine depth behind them.
